### Ship Boarding Protocol (Sector Operations)
Use this protocol when dealing with ships operating in the station sector.
Step
Requirement
1
Broadcast intent in both [bold]Traffic[/bold] and [bold]Common[/bold] before boarding action.
2
If boarding/search is warrant-based, send the warrant by fax where applicable before execution.
3
If the suspect vessel is combat-capable, order it to depower before boarding.
4
IFFless vessel status provides [bold]Reasonable Suspicion[/bold] for contact/investigation.
5
Mass-scanner radar red pings (red weapons icon or red shields) provide [bold]Probable Cause[/bold] for escalation/search action, but a warrant must still be obtained before any search unless another lawful exception applies.
[bold][color=#ffffff]Note[/color][/bold]
"Radar pings" in this protocol refers to mass-scanner console indicators showing guns in any color other than green, treated as C3-linked threat indicators.
